finding.contract: Current G2 requires causal cancel while old TTS audio is demonstrably active, then measurement of the bounded tail to the last old-packet-correlated sample.
finding.current_behavior: g2_pipewire_s2_runtime.py starts the cancel monitor, launches paplay, sleeps until a fixed cancel_after_ms offset, and invokes causal cancel. The analyzer proves a pre-cancel source/cancel alignment using an earlier probe, but neither runtime nor analyzer requires source-active + old-source-correlated monitor evidence in an interval immediately preceding the actual causal cancel instant.
finding.false_green: A fixed cancel point can land in a natural TTS pause or another silent interval. Earlier pre-cancel correlation can still be green, and post-bound silence can still be green, even though the terminal discriminator never demonstrated stopping audio that was active at cancellation.

relationship_to_existing_blockers.CANCEL_SOURCE_TIMELINE_CAUSALITY: This finding depends on the same repaired monotonic-to-stream/source-frame mapping. Once that mapping exists, active-at-cancel must be evaluated on the mapped source/monitor timeline rather than process-spawn time.
relationship_to_existing_blockers.POST_BOUND_WINDOW_STRADDLE: Independent: post-bound-only silence resolution does not prove pre-cancel activity.
relationship_to_existing_blockers.H4: Independent: H4 proves discriminative source/control activity after the bound; it does not prove old audio was active immediately before cancel in the cancel run.

minimal_trigger4_repair.goal: Prove the causal cancel actually interrupts an active old-audio interval without introducing a second playback or acceptance authority.
preferred_shape: After repairing exact stream/source-timeline binding, define a predeclared pre-cancel evidence interval immediately ending at the mapped cancel source position (for example a fixed 40-100 ms interval chosen before observing the cancel result).
Require the exact old source to be active in that interval and require the cancel-run monitor to be old-source-correlated with sufficient RMS/correlation there.

Prefer selecting the cancel target deterministically from a sustained-active region of the already bound run-local source/control evidence, then execute cancel when the exact playback stream reaches that mapped source position; do not move the cancel point after seeing the cancel result.
If active old audio cannot be established immediately pre-cancel, classify EVIDENCE_INVALID_CANCEL_NOT_PROVEN_DURING_ACTIVE_OLD_AUDIO and keep all G2 promotion credit zero.
Do not reinterpret earlier generic pre-cancel alignment as active-at-cancel proof.
required_regressions: Fixture with valid earlier pre-cancel alignment but silence at the mapped cancel interval must NOT terminal-pass.
Fixture with sustained old-source-correlated monitor audio immediately before mapped cancel and no post-bound old audio may pass this predicate if all other predicates pass.
Changing playback-client startup delay must not change which source interval is considered immediately pre-cancel once stream/source timing is bound.
Existing H4, post-bound-only scan, Piper runtime identity, latency-bound, cleanup taxonomy, replacement readback, packet fence, exact object identity and zero-credit fences remain intact.

execution_fence.next_action: Trigger4 folds active-at-cancel proof into the same G2 stream/source-timeline repair and focused regression set, then exactly one fresh repaired S2 subject may run if singleton ownership is clear.
